'''2017 MPC Andrew Moss DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Andrew Moss]] at [[2017 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Player:''' [[Andrew Moss]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Match Play Championship]]
